description:
The Air Force intends to solicit and award a firm fixed price single source purchase order to Gatan, L.L.C., Pleasanton, California; CAGE Code 0LP59, under the authority of FAR 12.201-1 Simplified Procedures for a EDXRF SPECTROMETER for the Oklahoma City Air Logistics Complex (OC-ALC), Tinker AFB Oklahoma.  

The NAICS code for this requirement is 334516 with a size standard of 1,000 employees

Contractor registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) – which results in receiving a unique, active CAGE Code – is required prior to receiving any contracts or orders from the Government in accordance with FAR 4.203-1(b) Contractors can register electronically at https://sam.gov/.
